messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there — I’ve been going through my rewards statements and something doesn’t seem right with my cash back. Could you help me figure out what’s going on?

I have both a Gold Rewards Card and an EcoCard, and the recent cash back totals don’t seem to add up, but I’m not sure which transactions are off. I also don’t have my phone on me right now to pull up statement details, so I’m hoping you can help investigate on your end.

{"reply":"I can help—thank you for the details. To investigate your cash back across your Gold Rewards Card and EcoCard I’ll need to access your account, so I must verify your identity first. Can you please provide your full name plus any two of the following (confirm any two):

- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email address on file
- Phone number on file
- Mailing address on file

Once you provide that, I’ll verify your account and then pull your card accounts and recent credit-card transactions to reconcile the cash-back totals and identify which transactions or statements don’t add up. If you’d prefer not to share these details here, I can transfer you to a human agent—would you like that instead?"}

Sure. My full name is Priya Sharma.

Two details to confirm:
- Date of birth: 11/03/1990  
- Phone number: 312-555-0481
